listing.name: Burnout 3: Takedown (PS2) (Burnout3 PC)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows alpha ZIP; own NTSC-U SLUS-21050 image Limits: PS2-specific Windows alpha, distinct from Xbox Burnout3; no Portcove completion claim. Upstream platforms: Windows10/11 x86-64 ZIP with source/preparation; no other documented package target established. Original data: Own Burnout 3: Takedown NTSC-U PS2 disc SLUS-21050 as ISO. Upstream setup reads/extracts that original disc and locally builds the translated program; keep required source image/data available per upstream configuration. PAL/NTSC-J editions are outside the documented target. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
